newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Commerce Bancshares upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Commerce Bancshares upgraded.

text.p: --Edward Jones said on Tuesday it upgraded its rating on Commerce Bancshares Inc to buy from hold due to the stock's valuation.
--It said the stock is attractively valued at 1.6 times book value while other regional bank stocks are valued closer to two times book value.
--"Our EPS estimates are also at the high end of the (range) and we think estimates are likely to be raised on Commerce Bancshares which will push the stock higher," it said in a report.
--Commerce Bancshares was trading at 39-7/8, up one in modday exchange trading.
